purpose: Native UI submission through automatically polling Staging service to a real provider and recovered native answer. Separate from the retained missing-direction clarification criterion.

cases.text: In a fictional navigation exercise, I am facing north and turn right by 90 degrees. Which direction am I facing now? Answer in one English sentence; no location or live information is needed.
在一次虚构的方向练习中，我面朝北，向右转90度后朝哪个方向？请用一句中文回答，不需要地点或实时信息。
